summary: The change passes. It raises `[parallel] max_concurrency` to 2 in athena.toml and fixes the stale "Left at 1" comment above it. It also adds the CHANGELOG entry under [Unreleased] ### Changed. The root cause of the earlier drain-test failures is fixed at its source: the shared test_config fixture now pins max_concurrency to 1, whatever value the live athena.toml holds. As a result, the tests' `max_concurrency = 1` replacements in drain.rs act on the fixture without being edited. Only the three allowed files changed, and no production code or schema did. I ran the drain suite (177 passed) and the athena-data tests (160 passed). The full test, clippy and fmt results come from Athena's CI record for this commit, which shows all three passing; I did not rerun them. One minor finding: two lines in docs/design/async-drain.md still say the repository's value is 1. That file is outside this job's scope, so it needs a separate change.
